{{Quote|Jedi business, go back to your drinks.|Anakin Skywalker, to Nyrat Agira and other clubgoers|audio=Anakin-JediBusiness-AOTC.flac|<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Nyrat Agira''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] clubgoer who was a member of the [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]] cult. The trendy cult member formed a regular group with her acquaintances [[Wilst Molan]] and [[Di Mantid]] that visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] looking for a [[Currency/Legends|rich]] and powerful mate. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she visited the Outlander Club with her friends [[Immi Danoo]] and [[Rosha Vess]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]].

Shortly after, she was once again in the club, competing for the title of best-dressed with her acquaintances. She was questioned by bounty hunter [[Kalyn Farnmir/Legends|Kalyn Farnmir]] about the [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] of the Zealots, [[Scri Oscuro]]. Agira, who was easily intimidated by Farnmir, revealed that Oscuro was on Coruscant, and that he had done dealings with Farnmir's partner, [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee]]. Later that [[Local day/Legends|night]], she drank and talked with Danoo, Vess, and another Human just as Wesell went into the establishment to hide. She and her friends watched as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disarmed Wesell and apprehended her. After the Jedi left, she identified a [[Unidentified weak-minded individual/Legends|weak-minded individual]] to convert to the cult.

==Biography==
===A trendy cultist===
[[File:Nyratagira.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Nyrat Agira visited the Outlander Club on Coruscant.]]
Nyrat Agira was a young<ref name="db" /> and trendy<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|14|Agira, Nyrat}}</ref> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] clubgoer<ref name="db" /> part of<ref name="Rogues">{{InsiderCite|136|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: A Night at the Outlander Club}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] party scene.<ref name="Rogues" /> She was always up to date on the latest fashion and she was well-known for her incredible [[Hair/Legends|hair]] creations.<ref name="FF" /> Agira was also a member of the [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]],<ref name="db" /> a fast-growing<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> female-empowering<ref name="Far Horizons">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref> religious<ref name="CSWEZealots">{{CSWECite|III|369|Zealots of Psusan}}</ref> cult<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> fashionable on Coruscant during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWEZealots" /> 

The cultist hopped around clubs with her friend [[Immi Danoo]], and [[Rosha Vess]], another friend who was also a member of the Zealots of Psusan.<ref name="Who's Who" /> With her acquaintances [[Wilst Molan]] and [[Di Mantid]], Agira formed a regular group that visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="FF" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> Though the group visited the club in hopes of finding a [[Currency/Legends|rich]] and powerful mate, they also competed with each other for the unofficial title of "best-dressed Outlander patron."<ref name="FF" />

===Farnmir's interrogation===
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC Note">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The scene from ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'' in which [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] is in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] takes place immediately before the film, meaning it must be set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Agira, Danoo, and Vess visited the Outlander Club. During the group's visit, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] entered the club and made preparations to assassinate [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> shortly after,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The events in [[Kalyn Farnmir/Legends|Kalyn Farnmir's]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry show Agira's interrogation happening shortly before Farnmir meeting [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee]], which is shown in the film. Therefore, the events in the Databank entry must take place in 22 BBY.</ref> Agira, wanting to stand out,<ref name="Who's Who" /> visited the Outlander Club again.<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> Other individuals at the club, like Molan and Mantid, attempted to surpass Agira's fashion, though they were no real competition.<ref name="FF" />

During the visit, Agira came face-to-face<ref name="db" /> with [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Kalyn Farnmir/Legends|Kalyn Farnmir]], who had recognized the cult [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on Agira's abdomen as a symbol of the Zealots of Psusan. Farnmir's partner, the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Cian Shee/Legends|Cian Shee]], had sold Farnmir out to the corrupt [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] of the cult, [[Scri Oscuro]]. Farnmir easily intimidated and interrogated the woman about the priest's<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir">{{DB|character|kalynfarnmir|Farnmir, Kalyn}}</ref> whereabouts and her tattoo.<ref name="CSWE" /> Agira confirmed that Oscuro, who was on Coruscant, had done dealings with Shee.<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> The information Farnmir acquired confirmed the bounty hunter's worst fears.<ref name="db" />

[[File:CoruscantGlam-ImageAttack.png|thumb|left|300px|Agira and her friends' attention was drawn by Obi-Wan Kenobi.]]
Later that night, Agira stood near the club's bar as she socialized and drank with Danoo, Vess, and another Human.  As the group did so, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered the club looking for Wesell after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on Amidala.<ref name="aotc" /> Agira and her friends' fleeting attention was drawn<ref name="Coruscant Glam">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/10/imageattack20021025.html|series=Image Attack|text=Coruscant Glam}}</ref> by Kenobi as he [[Dismemberment/Legends|cut off]] Wesell's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] when she attempted to ambush him, turning to stare as he did so. Skywalker told the clubgoers to go back to their drinks and the Jedi left with Wesell.<ref name="aotc" /> As the Jedi interrogated the bounty hunter outside, Agira left her friends and identified a [[Unidentified weak-minded individual/Legends|weak-minded individual]] to convert to the Zealots of Psusan. She walked away from the bar with the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] individual.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:NyratAgiraHead-TOS.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Nyrat Agira wore her hair in the latest solloops hairstyle.]]
A trendy<ref name="CSWE" /> woman, Agira was typical of the Coruscant club scene.<ref name="db" /> She was ditzy<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> and easily intimidated by Kalyn Farnmir when interrogated.<ref name="Kalyn Farnmir" /> Agira was friends with Immi Danoo and Rosha Vess<ref name="Who's Who" /> and acquaintances with Wilst Molan and Di Mantid. While the three acquainted clubgoers looked like friends, they were in fierce competition with each other for the unofficial title of "best-dressed Outlander patron," a title Agira usually won.<ref name="FF" /> She had a minimalist taste in [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]<ref name="Who's Who" /> and adorned herself in superficialities meant to catch the eye of a potential mate or a potential mark, like others of her age.<ref name="db" />

Agira was a lithe woman who was considered beautiful. She possessed [[Color/Legends|light]] skin<ref name="db" /> and auburn hair.<ref name="FF" /> The irises of her [[Eye/Legends|eye]]s were surgically altered to the less mundane hue<ref name="db" /> of blue.<ref name="aotcvis" /> On the night the Jedi apprehended Wesell, Agira wore her hair in the latest<ref name="FF" /> tall, curving [[Solloops hairstyles/Legends|solloops hairstyle]].<ref name="db" /> The trusses of<ref name="FF" /> sprayed curlicues<ref name="Who's Who" /> rose up from the back of her head like [[Snake/Legends|serpents]].<ref name="FF" /> She had a visible<ref name="CSWE" /> tattoo of the Zealots of Psusan's<ref name="db" /> starburst<ref name="Who's Who" /> mark<ref name="db" /> around her navel, betraying her spiritual devotion,<ref name="aotcvis" /> or at least denoting another passing trend.<ref name="db" />

==Skills and abilities==
Agira was able to stay up to date with the latest fashion, which on Coruscant could change with dizzying speed. Her hair creations were considered incredible, and she became well known for them.<ref name="FF" />

==Equipment==
Agira wore fashionably impractical clothes made from soluble [[zoosha fabric]].<ref name="db" /> While in the Outlander Club, she wore a charismatic<ref name="FF" /> outfit consisting of a red top,<ref name="aotcvis" /> red leggings<ref name="DepthCommentary">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> made from zoosha fabric, and a pair of red heels.<ref name="aotcvis" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Episode II extra===
[[File:NyratAgiraDatabank.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Nyrat Agira was portrayed by an uncredited extra.]]
Nyrat Agira was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="aotc" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year2">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The Outlander Club scenes including Agira, who was portrayed by an uncredited extra,<ref name="aotc" /> were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Agira and other patrons of the Outlander Club were named by [[George Lucas]] and his film production company [[Lucasfilm]] during the summer of 2000 in anticipation of licensing and spin-off fiction opportunities.<ref name="crc">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> 

Prior to the film's release, the character was first revealed when the extra playing her, in costume, introduced the seventh episode of the Episode II behind-the-scenes video series [[On location|''on location'']].<ref name="On location">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/7.html|series=On Location|text=Part 7 - Color Me Star Wars}}</ref> The episode, "Color Me Star Wars," was released on [[September 12]], 2000.<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref> Agira was later identified in the [[StarWars.com]] article "Making Up is Hard to Do: Lesley Vanderwalt," which was published on [[February 15]], 2002.<ref name="Lesley Vanderwalt">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/feature/20020215/index.html|text=Making Up is Hard to Do: Lesley Vanderwalt}}</ref> The character then first appeared in an illustration in the young-readers book ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'', written by [[Eric Arnold]], illustrated by [[Valerie Reckert]],<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> and released on [[April 23]], 2002.<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref> The image of her in the book<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> was taken from the then-upcoming film.<ref name="aotc" />

===In other material===
{{Quote|Nyrat's equally dolled-up friends Immi Danoo and Rosha Vess suggest that the club-hopping trio might be the intergalactic embodiment of the Valley Girl stereotype.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Who's Who" />}}
[[File:ImmiDanooConcept.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Concept art for Immi Danoo (pictured) was erroneously used in the Databank entry for Nyrat Agira.]]
Agira's StarWars.com [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry,<ref name="db" /> published on [[June 14]], 2002,<ref name="Coruscant Nightlife">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2002/06/news20020614.html|text=Coruscant Nightlife}}</ref> incorrectly used artist [[Dermot Power|Dermot Power's]] concept art of Immi Danoo<ref name="Who's Who" /> in its "Behind the Scenes" section.<ref name="db" /> In ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', a reference book written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]]<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> and published on [[April 3]], [[2003]],<ref name="Cargo">{{DK|subdomain=uk|url=nf/Book/BookDisplay/0,,11_0751365165,00.html|text=Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Attack of the Clones|nolive=1}}</ref> and in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 96|ninety-sixth]] issue of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine, written by [[Iain Lowson]]<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref> and published by [[De Agostini]]<ref name="FF" /> on [[October 29]], 2003,<ref name="FFDate">{{FFdates|96}}</ref> Nyrat Agira is incorrectly named "Agira Nyrat."<ref name="FF" /><ref name="Inside" /> The magazine also misspells her name as "Agirat."<ref name="FF" /> The mistake in ''Inside of the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones'' was later republished in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|Star Wars: Complete Locations]]''<ref name="Complete Locations" /> on [[October 17]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year2" />

In the article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Who's Who" /> on [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> author [[Daniel Wallace]] states that Agira and her friends' looks suggest the trio are the intergalactic embodiment of the [[Wikipedia:Valley girl|Valley girl stereotype]].<ref name="Who's Who" /> On [[September 30]], [[2005]],<ref name="DBrwdate">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20050930.html|text=Hyperspace Presents: What's The Story, Round 2}}</ref> Kalyn Farnmir's Databank entry, which included Agira, was posted. Farnmir was further fleshed out by [[Captain Yossarian|Benjamin Christopher Norton Dawe]], writing under the alias "Captain Yossarian," through the StarWars.com "[[What's The Story?]]" feature. In [[2007]], Dawe published the original draft of the story through ''[[Star Wars: Blogs]]''. The original draft included differences left unpublished, such as Farnmir jamming her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] in Agira's belly, and Agira pointing at Cian Shee.<ref name="Yossarian">{{Blog|Yossarian|3|Kalyn Farnmir and Romeo Treblanc - Better Late Than Never}}</ref>

Pictures of Agira at the Outlander from Episode II<ref name="aotc" /> were used in the background of the webcomic ''[[Rookies: Rendezvous|Rookies: Rendezous]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="rookies">''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]''</ref> and published from [[February 6|Feburary 6]], [[2006]],<ref name="WeekOne">{{Blog|pablog|47|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week One Annotations}}</ref> to [[May 10]], 2006.<ref name="Week13">{{Blog|pablog|70|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Thirteen Annotations -- Finale}}</ref> As the pictures are repurposed and represent a gambling establishment on<ref name="rookies" /> the planet<ref name="ff">{{FactFile|116|ORD 1-2|Ord Mantell}}</ref> [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]<ref name="rookies" /> around the year [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="rookiesdate">{{Blog|pablog|50|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Three Annotations}} states that ''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]'' is set around the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which is set in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> this article assumes the pictures do not constitute an appearance of Agira.
